Science Communication
(journal)
Science Communication
is a
peer-reviewed
academic journal
that covers the field of
communication of science and technology
. The
editor-in-chief
is Lee Ann Kahlor (
University of Texas at Austin
). It was established in 1979 as
Knowledge: Creation, Diffusion, Utilization
, obtaining its current name in 1994, and is published by
SAGE Publications
.
Abstracting and indexing
The journal is abstracted and indexed in
Scopus
,
CAB Abstracts databases
,
ERIC
,
EBSCO databases
,
ProQuest databases
, and the
Social Sciences Citation Index
. According to the
Journal Citation Reports
, the journal has a 2023
impact factor
of 4.6.
